# Channel scoreboard — per-channel, per-work-class track record

Feeds routing decisions (delegation-protocol R5) and the harness `priors` hook.
Score = verifier score in [0,1]. Update at every task close-out. Retirements
(w≥3 failures on a class) recorded in the notes column with date + reason.

| Channel | Work class | Attempts | Mean | Recent scores (new→old) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| QA agent (fleet, Secuura #922 (KS-679 Anchor.id format-true + E7 widening, T2 r1) @ `8664826e5`, pane `%100`, 2026-09-18 10:5x → 11:15 AEST; scored by Wednesday at its verdict 01:14Z) | QA gate tier 2 round 1 (spec example + secret-detector guard) | 1 | 0.95 | 0.95 | **GO WITH FINDINGS.** Answered the lead question by MEASUREMENT: no repo credential takes the exempted `<prefix>_<uuid>` shape (21 exact-shape sites, 14 prefixes, all record IDs; real API keys `sk_`+64hex stay caught). **Its best finding, F1:** the widening is broader than its cells pin, so `token_<uuid>` / `secret_<uuid>` go from caught to seen by NOTHING (E7 is the only name-blind secret rule), and five loosenings read 0 red. Also caught that the seat's own red-proof claim was false (F2), that eslint applies `rules: {}` to scripts/*.mjs so 'eslint rc 0' checked nothing (F6), and self-corrected its NOT-TESTED in the open (F8). **-0.05:** F7 wrote *no preflight record exists at 8664826e5*, which is FALSE (seat A's push.out :1009-1031, verified by me). In fairness, it was only given the PR snapshot and my pointer tap was refused, so the miss traces to my drafting, not the gate. I raised F1 from Minor to fix-before-merge because #922 creates the hole. |
| QA agent (fleet, Secuura #1037 (KS-1101 health aggregates surface degraded, T1 r1) @ `f87506f47`, pane `%99`, 2026-09-18 10:3x → 11:00 AEST; scored by Wednesday at its verdict 01:00Z) | QA gate tier 1 round 1 (health aggregates + readiness regression) | 1 | 1.00 | 1.00 | **GO WITH FINDINGS**, no Blocker, no Major. Proved the bug with a positive control (develop shows a 200 degraded service as up on ALL SEVEN aggregate cells) and the fix at head and merged. Readiness regression measured, not asserted: **40 cells × 3 trees, 0 HTTP differences.** MEASURED all three declared findings rather than restating them: F-1 smoke-test flips 5/0→4/1; F-2 is 404 by default, reads healthy when opted in, and nothing sets it. NEW N-1 (operator troubleshooting now calls degraded critical and says restart), which a reader would miss. **Raised a SYSTEMIC finding outside its brief: O-1, CI jobs never start** (0 steps, no runner, ~3 s) on #1037, #1034 AND develop, with controls on all three. Also recorded its own two scripted-edit slips publicly. |
| QA agent (fleet, Secuura #1034 (KS-1215 revoked-session Bearer forward, T1 r1) @ `e4624218b`, pane `%97`, 2026-09-18 09:26:54 → 10:03 AEST, 36 min; scored by Wednesday at its verdict 00:02Z, spf/dkim/dmarc pass) | QA gate tier 1 round 1 (44 develop-forwarding routes, both modes, both prefixes) | 1 | 1.00 | 1.00 | **GO WITH FINDINGS**, no Blocker, no Major on a path #1034 changed. **Exceptional run.** Closed the class with real numbers (revoked-session forward 0 of 3,258 cells at head vs 558 at develop; register-connector forward 24→0, exactly those 24 cells changed, 0 status differences; planted controls firing). **Three things beyond the verdict earned the score:** (a) a READ that RAISED the pre-gate severity — `tenant-provisioning` re-forwards the inbound Authorization to security *for authz + audit*, so a revoked session had been authorising a key mint, not merely leaking a header; (b) it graded the reachable-vs-unreachable distinction honestly rather than inflating — the cache-get-throws HANG filed as a TICKET candidate, NOT a Blocker, because 72 adversarial + 9,774 census cells said nothing reaches it; (c) a **public self-correction**: its first reachability harness leaked a listener ~10 min because cleanup sat in the loop tail not the `finally` — caught by its own MID census, ended by verif
